dedupe_keys.name: kenya per capita food consumption 2017 and 2018 food balance sheet extract

description: This table gives the average quantity of each food commodity consumed per person in Kenya, in kilograms per year, for 2017 and 2018. It was produced by the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics from its food balance sheet, the national accounting framework promoted by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations that tracks the supply and use of each commodity in primary equivalent, and it is shared on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. Coverage is national, one value per commodity and year. The file is a single spreadsheet, free to download under a Creative Commons Attribution licence. Caveats: the dataset covers only two years and was published in 2019, the KNBS organisation page on the exchange is marked inactive, and food balance sheet consumption is apparent availability derived from production, trade and stock changes, not measured intake. Simulation uses: baseline per capita demand by commodity for food supply chain and shortage models in Kenya. Related records: the traceable food balance sheets (data-traceable-food-balance-sheets-gcamfaostat) and FAOSTAT (data-faostat) give the same framework for all countries.
